# pdf-report-engine — full reference (for AI agents)

Exhaustive field-level companion to [`llms.txt`](./llms.txt). Read `llms.txt` first
for the mental model; use this file when you need every option for a specific block,
table, chart, font or encryption setting. All content is derived from the shipped
TypeScript declarations (`dist/index.d.ts` and re-exported `dist/ir/schema.d.ts`).

- The npm Node entry point is ESM-only and requires Node ≥ 18. This Node requirement
  does not apply to the separate prebuilt browser bundle.
- Geometry: a `Length` is a `number` (points) or a unit string (`'12pt'`, `'5mm'`,
  `'1in'`, `'24px'`, `'50%'`). pt = 1/72 in; mm/cm/in/px are converted for you.
- Colors (`ColorInput`): `'#rgb'`, `'#rrggbb'`, `'#rrggbbaa'`, `'rgb()'`/`'rgba()'`,
  `'hsl()'`/`'hsla()'`, a `number`, or a named CSS colour.

---

## Browser ESM bundle

- The prebuilt browser bundle is `browser/pdf-report-engine.js`; `npm run build:browser`
  generates it and mirrors it to `docs/browser/pdf-report-engine.js`.
- The bundle includes pdfkit's browser build and can be loaded with `<script type="module">`
  or `import()`. A classic non-module script is unsupported. It runs in a browser; Node ≥ 18
  applies only to the npm package's Node entry point.
- `import { htmlToReportDoc, renderToBuffer } from './browser/pdf-report-engine.js'`.
  Convert HTML with `htmlToReportDoc` (or construct a `ReportDoc`), then call
  `await renderToBuffer(report)` to get PDF bytes. Use `new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/pdf' })`
  to preview or download the result.
- Keep `wawoff2-decoder.js` beside the bundle when WOFF2 decoding may be needed. Browser font
  files must be fetched and passed as bytes; the browser cannot read installed system fonts.
- The npm package's published `files` list omits the prebuilt `browser/` directory. When using
  the package source in a browser app, bundle it with the required pdfkit polyfills; alternatively,
  serve the prebuilt browser files from the repository/CDN. No Chromium or headless browser is
  required. Move heavy rendering to a Web Worker to avoid blocking the UI.

```js
import { htmlToReportDoc, renderToBuffer } from './browser/pdf-report-engine.js';

const report = htmlToReportDoc('<h1>Hello from the browser</h1>');
const bytes = await renderToBuffer(report);
const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
const link = document.createElement('a');
link.href = url;
link.download = 'report.pdf';
link.click();
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
```

---

## 1. Public API (from `pdf-report-engine`)

### Render entry points
- `renderToBuffer(report: ReportDoc, options?: RenderOptions): Promise<Buffer>`
  Async one-shot. Resolves remote `http(s)` images and `report.fonts`
  (Google-Fonts links, `@font-face`, font URLs) into embedded faces, then returns the
  full PDF. **Default choice.**
- `renderToStream(report: ReportDoc, options?: RenderOptions): Promise<ReadableStream<Uint8Array>>`
  Async; same resolution as `renderToBuffer` but emits bytes incrementally and forces
  `bufferPages: false` (lower peak memory, ideal for server responses).
- `createReport(report: ReportDoc, options?: RenderOptions): { doc, pages, registry }`
  **Synchronous, offline.** Returns the live `pdfkit` `doc` (call `doc.end()` and pipe
  it), the paginated `pages: Page[]`, and the `FontRegistry`. Does **not** fetch remote
  images/fonts — pass local `options.fonts` and file/`data:`/byte image `src` only.

### `RenderOptions`
```jsonc
{
  "fonts": [ /* FontSource[]: { family, weight?, style?, buffers: Uint8Array[] } — required for createReport */ ],
  "now": () => new Date(),          // injectable clock for now() (deterministic tests)
  "baseStyle": { /* Partial<StyleProps> */ }, // overrides report.style before inheritance
  "accessibility": { "language": "en-US" }, // optional tagged output; not a PDF/UA claim
  "pdfa": "PDF/A-2b",               // optional; requires all fonts embedded, rejects encryption
  "bufferPages": true,              // false = flush each page (renderToStream sets this)
  "images": {                       // how http(s) image src is resolved (async renders)
    "resolveImage": async (url) => Uint8Array,  // custom loader (proxy/auth/cache)
    "allowedHosts": ["cdn.example.com"],        // optional allowlist
    "timeoutMs": 10000,
    "onError": "throw" | "skip"                 // default skip
  },
  "resolveFonts": { /* FontResolveOptions: same idea for report.fonts */ }
}
```

### Adapters and lower-level exports
- `htmlToReportDoc(html: string, options?: HtmlOptions): ReportDoc` — HTML subset → IR.
  `HtmlOptions = { style?: Partial<StyleProps>, data?: Record<string, unknown>, baseDir?: string }`
  (`baseDir` lets relative `<img src>` resolve).
- `parseHtml(html): HNode[]` — the forgiving tokenizer (rarely needed directly).
- `resolveRemoteImages(report, opts?)`, `resolveRemoteFonts(report, opts?)`,
  `parseFontFace(css)`, `collectCharset(doc|html)` — pre-pass helpers.
- `readFontFiles(...)`, `FontRegistry`, `setImageFileReader`, `setImagePathAccess`,
  `imagePathAccessEnabled` — font/image host hooks.
- Units: `toPt`, `resolveLen`, `expandBox`, `MM_TO_PT`, `CM_TO_PT`, `IN_TO_PT`, `PX_TO_PT`.
- Page: `resolvePage(spec)`. Pagination: `paginate(input)`.
- Types exported: `ReportDoc, Block, ParagraphBlock, HeadingBlock, TableBlock,
  SpacerBlock, PageBreakBlock, ImageBlock, SvgBlock, FlexBlock, FlexItem, ColumnBlock,
  ChartBlock, ChartKind, ChartSeries, GanttTask, ReferenceLine, ValueAxisOptions,
  TocBlock, BarcodeBlock, BarcodeSymbology, BandContent, BandType, StyleProps,
  BoxProps, Content, ContentSpan, ColumnNode, RowNode, CellNode, GroupNode,
  DataSource, Expr, FontReference, WatermarkSpec, EncryptionSpec, PdfPermissions,
  BoxShadow, LinearGradient, RenderOptions, RenderResult`.

---

## 2. `ReportDoc` (root)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `info` | `{ title?, author?, subject?, keywords?, creator?, producer? }` | `title` may be an `Expr`; written to PDF metadata. |
| `language` | `string` | Document language used when tagged accessibility output is enabled. |
| `page` | `PageSpec` | see §3. |
| `style` | `Partial<StyleProps>` | base style inherited down the whole tree. |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown>` | arrays/objects read by expressions (`$data`) and table `dataSource`. |
| `variables` | `Record<string, unknown>` | extra symbols available as `$vars.<name>` in any expression. |
| `bands` | `Partial<Record<BandType, BandContent>>` | see §4. |
| `body` | `Block[]` | flowing content. |
| `fonts` | `FontReference[]` | declarative remote fonts (resolved by the async renders). |
| `outline` | `boolean` | PDF bookmarks from headings; auto-on when headings exist, `false` suppresses. |
| `watermark` | `WatermarkSpec` | see §10. |
| `encrypt` | `EncryptionSpec` | see §11. |

---

## 3. `PageSpec`

```jsonc
{ "size": "a4", "orientation": "portrait" | "landscape", "margin": 56 }
```
- **`size`**: `'a3'|'a4'|'a5'|'b4'|'b5'|'letter'|'legal'|'tabloid'|'executive'`, a
  `[Length, Length]` tuple, `{ width, height }` (pt), or `'8.5in x 11in'` style string.
  Default `'a4'`.
- **`margin`**: a single `Length`, or CSS-shorthand arrays of 1–4 `Length`s
  (`[v,h]`, `[t,h,b]`, `[t,r,b,l]`). Default `20mm`.
- `orientation` swaps width/height so the page is landscape/portrait regardless of size.

---

## 4. Bands (Jasper-style regions)

`BandType = 'pageHeader' | 'pageFooter' | 'title' | 'summary' | 'background'`

`BandContent = { blocks?: Block[], text?: Content, style?: Partial<StyleProps>, height?: number }`
- `title` renders once at the very start; `summary` once at the end; `pageHeader`/
  `pageFooter` repeat on every page; `background` sits behind every page.
- `height` fixes the band height; omit it and the band is measured from its blocks.
- **Running tokens** `{PAGE}` and `{TOTAL}` and `$page.number`/`$page.total`
  resolve **only inside bands** (not in `body`). `resetPageNumber` on a group restarts
  the counter at a group boundary.

---

## 5. Content model

`Content = string | number | ContentSpan | Array<string | number | ContentSpan>`

`ContentSpan = { text?: Content, bind?: string | Expr, format?: string,
style?: Partial<StyleProps>, children?: Content, link?: string }`
- `bind` → an expression result (see §6). `format` → a number/date pattern applied to
  the bound value. `style` → per-run overrides (bold/colour/etc.) inside a paragraph.
- `link` → an absolute URL (`https:`, `mailto:`, `tel:`) or an internal `#anchor`
  (matches a block/heading whose `id` — the IR `id` or an HTML element's `id` — equals
  the anchor). Emits a real PDF link.

`Expr = { expr: string, scope?: 'row'|'group'|'report'|'page', type? }`. In JS you can
usually pass the bare string wherever `string | Expr` is accepted.

---

## 6. Expression grammar (full)

Evaluated in a `Proxy`-whitelisted sandbox — **no raw `eval` of globals**.

**Scope variables**
| Token | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `$data` / `$report` | the report `data` object |
| `$vars` | the report `variables` map |
| `$row.<col>` | current table row; bound columns (`columns[].key`) are also unprefixable |
| `$item` | current `data-each="item in ..."` iteration value |
| `$value` | current cell value (in cells / `<td data-bind>`), or a computed aggregate |
| `$index` | 0-based row index within the current group |
| `$group.<colKey>_<fn>` | aggregate over the current group: `_sum _avg _count _min _max`; plus `$group.<key>` = group key value, `$group.rowCount` = row count |
| `$page.number` / `$page.total` | running page numbers (bands only) |

**Functions** (also available: standard JS `Math`, `Date`, `JSON`, `Number`, `String`)
- Aggregates: `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, `count`, `rows`, `rowCount`, `groupCount`.
- Position: `isFirst`, `isFirstRow`, `isLast`, `isLastRow`.
- Logic: `cond(test, thenValue, elseValue)` (lazy — only the taken branch evaluates).
- Formatting: `format(value, pattern)`, `money(v, symbol?, digits?)` (default `$`, 2),
  `percent(v, digits?)` (`v*100` + `%`), `number(v, pattern?)`.
  - Date pattern letters: `yy yyyy M MM MMM d dd HH hh mm ss a`.
  - Number pattern: `0 . , % $ ( ) - + ; E * # ¤` and `'literal'`.
- Text: `lower`, `upper`, `trim`, `concat`, `length`, `abs`, `round`, `floor`, `ceil`.
- Time: `now()`, `date(...)`.

---

## 7. Blocks — full per-kind reference

Common to every block (`BlockBase extends BoxProps extends StyleProps`):
`id`, `visible?: boolean | Expr`, `styleWhen?: StyleCondition[]`, plus all
`StyleProps` (§8) and `BoxProps` (§9) fields.

### `paragraph`
`{ type: 'paragraph', content: Content }`

### `heading`
`{ type: 'heading', content, level?: 1..6, outline?: { level?, numbering?: 'append'|'none' } | false }`
Headings feed the PDF outline and any `toc` block.

### `spacer`
`{ type: 'spacer', size?: number }` — vertical gap (pt).

### `pageBreak`
`{ type: 'pageBreak' }` — starts the next page. Never breaks at the top of a page, so
consecutive breaks cannot blank a page. (`always` is accepted and ignored.)

### `image` (raster)
`{ type: 'image', src: string | Uint8Array, intrinsic?: {width,height}, alt? }`
`src` = filesystem path, `data:` URI, or raw bytes; passed to pdfkit unchanged.
Sizing: explicit `width`/`height` honoured exactly; one given → the other follows the
intrinsic aspect ratio (probed from the file header, no pdfkit in layout); neither →
intrinsic px size at 96 dpi, capped to the content width. PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP.

### `svg` (vector)
`{ type: 'svg', src, intrinsic?, alt? }` — inline `<svg>`, `data:image/svg+xml`, a
`.svg` path, or a remote SVG URL (fetched by the async pre-pass). Drawn as real PDF
paths (crisp at any zoom). Subset: `path` (all commands incl. arcs), `rect`, `circle`,
`ellipse`, `line`, `polyline`, `polygon`, nested `g` with `transform`, and
fill/stroke incl. `fill-rule` (even-odd holes), opacity, dash arrays. Text, gradients,
filters, clip/mask are **not** modelled (a gradient fill falls back to solid).

### `chart`
```jsonc
{
  "type": "chart", "kind": "bar",
  "title": "Revenue", "categories": ["Q1","Q2","Q3"],  // or CSV string or binding
  "series": [ { "name": "2025", "values": [12,18,9], "color": "#1a3d6d", "type": "bar", "axis": "left" } ],
  "stacked": false | true | "100%",
  "legend": "none" | "top" | "bottom" | "right",
  "colors": ["#..."],            // palette when a series has no color
  "showValues": true,            // value labels above bars/points
  "valueAxis": { "min","max","ticks","format","labels","gridLines" },
  "rightAxis": { /* ValueAxisOptions, combo secondary axis */ },
  "referenceLines": [ { "value": 100, "label": "Target", "color","axis","dash" } ],
  "range": true,                 // bar charts: draw high–low range bars (series.low/high)
  "totals": [0, 3],              // waterfall: category indices drawn as running-total bars
  "waterfallColors": { "increase","decrease","total" },
  "innerRadius": 0.55,           // donut hole fraction
  "plotHeight": 160,             // pt
  "gaugeValue": ..., "gaugeMax": 100,
  "heatmapLabels": true, "heatmapColors": { "from","to" },
  "ganttTasks": [ { "name","start","duration"|"end","color","dependsOn":[0],"progress":0.5 } ],
  "ganttStart","ganttEnd","ganttUnit": "day"|"week"|"month"
}
```
`ChartKind = 'bar'|'line'|'area'|'pie'|'donut'|'combo'|'waterfall'|'scatter'|'bubble'|
'radar'|'gauge'|'heatmap'|'gantt'` (any other value falls back to `bar`).
`ChartSeries.values` accepts a number array, a CSV string `'12,18,9'`, or a binding
(`'$data.revenue'`). Pie/donut read slices from `series[0].values` labelled by
`categories`; every other kind maps one value per category per series. `combo` mixes
per-series `type` (`bar`/`line`/`area`) and `axis` (`left`/`right`). Scatter/bubble use
`xValues`/`rValues`; range bars use `low`/`high`.

### `toc`
`{ type: 'toc', title?, maxLevel?: 3, leaders?: true, indent?: 12,
pageNumbers?: true, gap?: 4 }` — generated from heading blocks. The renderer runs a
bounded fixed-point loop (≤4 passes) so real page numbers stabilise.

### `barcode`
`{ type: 'barcode', symbology: 'qr'|'code128'|'ean13', value: Content,
moduleSize?, errorCorrection?: 'L'|'M'|'Q'|'H' (QR, default M), quietZone?: 4 (QR),
showText?: true (1D), color? }` — dependency-free encoders, emitted as merged vector
rectangles. `ean13` takes 12 digits (checksum appended) or 13 (checksum validated).

### `flex`
```jsonc
{ "type": "flex", "direction": "row"|"column", "wrap": false,
  "justify": "flex-start"|"center"|"flex-end"|"space-between"|"space-around"|"space-evenly",
  "alignItems": "flex-start"|"center"|"flex-end"|"stretch",
  "gap": 8, "rowGap": , "columnGap": ,
  "children": [ { "block": { /* any Block */ }, "grow":1, "shrink":1, "basis": "auto", "alignSelf": "center" } ] }
```
Laid out as a **single atomic fragment** (never splits across pages). `display: flex`
in HTML maps here.

### `columns`
`{ type: 'columns', count?: 2, gap?: 12, rule?: boolean | {color,width}, children: Block[] }`
Distributes children across N equal-width sub-columns, balanced by height and kept
atomic. CSS `column-count: N` in HTML maps here.

### `table`
```jsonc
{
  "type": "table",
  "columns": [ { "key","width","grow","minWidth","align","style","colorScale" } ],
  "headerRows": [ /* RowNode kind:'header' */ ],   // repeat on every page (repeatHeader)
  "footerRows": [ /* RowNode */ ],
  "staticRows": [ /* RowNode with their own cell styling */ ],
  "dataSource": [ {..}, {..} ] | { "bind": "$data.rows" } | { "each": "row", "of": "$data.rows" },
  "detail": { "cells": [ { "bind": "amount", "format": "#,##0.00" } ] },  // template per row
  "groups": [ { "by": "$row.region", "header","footer","headerStyle","footerStyle",
                "pageBreak","resetPageNumber" } ],
  "repeatHeader": true,        // false opts the per-page header repetition out
  "striped": true | { "color": "#f2f2f2" },
  "showGrid": true | BorderShorthand,
  "rowStyle": { /* Partial<StyleProps> */ } | ((row, index) => Partial<StyleProps>)
}
```
- **`ColumnNode`**: `width` (pt `Length`; a % is NOT resolved against the table),
  `grow` (weight to share leftover width), `minWidth` (default = widest unbreakable
  word), `align`, `style` (body-cell default), `colorScale` (column heatmap), `key`
  (binds `columns[].key` → row field, and makes `$row.<key>` unprefixable).
- **`RowNode`**: `cells: CellNode[]`, `kind?`
  (`'header'|'detail'|'groupHeader'|'groupFooter'|'subtotal'|'grandTotal'`),
  `visible?` (per-row filter — falsy drops the row), `styleWhen?`, `breakInside?`,
  `keepWithNext?`, `minHeight?`. Rows are normally atomic; an oversized top-aligned,
  text-only detail row can split at safe shared line boundaries unless `breakInside: 'avoid'`
  is set. Rich-block cells and vertically merged rows remain atomic.
- **`CellNode`**: `content?` (`Content`) **or** `blocks?: Block[]` (rich cell: images,
  barcodes, charts, nested tables, paragraphs — `content` wins if both), `colSpan?`,
  `rowSpan?`, `align` (incl. `'justify'`), `verticalAlign`, `style?`, `border?`,
  `padding*?`, `backgroundColor?`, `visible?`, `styleWhen?`, `colorScale?`,
  `diagonal?: DiagonalHeader` (split corner header: `{top,bottom,dir:'tl'|'tr',line}`),
  `format?`.
- **`GroupNode.footer`** may be an **array** (multiple blocks) — e.g. a subtotal line.
- Deprecated-and-ignored: `subtotal` (cell), `groupStyle`, `widows`/`orphans`,
  `subtotalToken`, `showRowSeparators` (use `showGrid`), `group.headerRepeat`/`label`.

---

## 8. `StyleProps` (inherited)

`fontFamily: string | string[]` (an array = per-glyph fallback stack, first family that
contains the glyph wins) · `fontSize` · `fontWeight: number | 'normal' | 'bold'` ·
`fontStyle: 'normal'|'italic'|'oblique'` · `color` · `backgroundColor` · `opacity`
(0..1) · `lineHeight: number | 'normal'` · `letterSpacing` · `align: 'left'|'center'|
'right'|'justify'` · `verticalAlign: 'top'|'middle'|'bottom'` · `textDecoration:
('underline'|'line-through')[]` · `features: Record<string, boolean>` (OpenType, e.g.
`{ tnum: true }`) · `fontVariant: 'normal'|'small-caps'|'tabular-nums'` · `whiteSpace:
'normal'|'nowrap'|'pre-wrap'` · `textTransform: 'none'|'uppercase'|'lowercase'|'capitalize'`.

## 9. `BoxProps` (adds non-inherited box/pagination fields)

All of `StyleProps` plus: `width`/`height`/`minHeight` (`number | string`),
`margin{Top,Right,Bottom,Left}`, `padding{Top,Right,Bottom,Left}`,
`border`/`border{Top,Right,Bottom,Left}: BorderShorthand`
(`ColorInput` | `[width, color]` | `[width, style, color]`; `BorderStyle =
'solid'|'dashed'|'dotted'|'double'|'none'`),
`breakBefore`/`breakAfter: 'auto'|'page'|'avoid'` (only `'page'` is honoured for
before/after; `'avoid'` there is ignored), `breakInside: 'auto'|'avoid'`,
`keepWithNext?: boolean`, `borderRadius` (rounds the **fill** only; a straight border is
never curved; CSS shorthand tuple order), `boxShadow?: BoxShadow`
(`{offsetX,offsetY,blur,color,opacity,inset}` — `inset` and `spread` are dropped),
`backgroundImage?: LinearGradient` (`{direction,from,to}` two-stop; direction snaps to
4 axes; painted **instead of** `backgroundColor`),
and out-of-flow: `position: 'absolute'|'fixed'|'static'|'relative'`, `left`/`top`
(`Length`, % of page dim), `zIndex?` (negative = behind body), `page?: number|'all'`
(for `absolute`; `fixed` repeats every page), `rotate?: number` (degrees CCW about the
block centre; kept atomic). Valid on top-level `body`/band blocks, not inside a table
cell or flex item.

---

## 10. `WatermarkSpec`

`{ text: string, rotate?: number (default -35), fontSize?: number (default 72),
color? (default '#c0c0c0'), opacity? (default 0.18), fontFamily?,
layer?: 'background'|'foreground' (default background) }`
Drawn on every page as rotated, semi-transparent **vector outlines** (non-selectable).
HTML: `data-watermark="DRAFT"` on `<body>` (with `data-watermark-rotate` etc.) or
`<meta name="watermark" content="…">`.

## 11. `EncryptionSpec`

`{ userPassword?, ownerPassword?, permissions?: PdfPermissions }` — RC4 128-bit via
pdfkit. At least one password is required or the doc stays unencrypted (byte-identical
to before). `permissions: { printing, modifying, copying, annotating, fillingForms,
contentAccessibility, documentAssembly }` — each `true` grants the capability. A
permissions-only spec with no password is ignored (pdfkit only installs the handler
when a password is present).

## 12. `FontReference` (declarative remote fonts)

```jsonc
[
  { "type": "google",    "url": "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=..." },
  { "type": "font-face", "css": "@font-face { font-family:'X'; src:url('https://.../x.woff2'); }" },
  { "type": "url", "url": "https://.../font.otf", "family": "X", "weight": 400, "style": "normal", "postscriptName": "X-Regular" }
]
```
Resolved to embedded faces by `renderToBuffer`/`renderToStream` (a failed remote font is
skipped, not fatal). For **CJK/Unicode coverage** you don't name a font per block —
the engine does per-glyph fallback across all registered faces and subsets each font to
the characters actually used. With `createReport` (offline) instead pre-resolve with
`resolveRemoteFonts(...)` and pass the result into `options.fonts`, or use
`readFontFiles`.

---

## 13. HTML adapter — full mapping

`htmlToReportDoc(html, { style?, data?, baseDir? })`. Supported markup:
- **Block tags:** `h1..h6` (→ heading), `p` (paragraph), `div/section/article/
  header/footer/main` (container), `ul/ol/li` (list), `table`, `hr` (rule), `img`,
  inline `<svg>`, `blockquote`.
- **Inline tags:** `b/strong` (bold), `i/em` (italic), `u/ins` (underline), `span`,
  `font`, `a` (→ `link`), `mark` (highlight), `br` (U+2028 line separator).
- **CSS:** flat subset of inline `style`; a `<style>`/linked stylesheet with class rules
  (`.toc { outline: true }`, `table { width: 100% }`) is honoured. `display: flex` →
  flex block; `column-count` → columns block; `transform: rotate(Ndeg)` → `rotate`.
- **Page:** `<meta name="pdf-page" content="size=a4; margin=48; orientation=landscape">`
  or `@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 15mm }` (a JS `report.page` still wins).
- **Fonts:** `<link href="fonts.googleapis.com/…">` and `@import` → `report.fonts`.
- **Data attributes** (the hallucination-prone area — these are the exact names; there is
  **no `data-col`/`data-label`/`data-field`/`data-expr`/`data-anchor`**):
  `data-band` (→ band region), `data-each="item in $data.list"` / `data-bind="$data.list"`
  on `<table>` (→ dataSource; the `<tbody>` first `<tr>` is the row template and each cell's
  `data-bind="<field>"` names the column `key`), `data-format` (pattern on a bound leaf/cell),
  `data-if="<expr>"` (visibility / per-row filter), `data-when="<expr>"` +
  `data-when-style="<css>"` (conditional style), `data-color-scale="min=;max=;from=;to=;text="`
  (numeric heatmap), `data-diagonal` (+ `data-diagonal-top`/`-bottom`/`-line` split header),
  `data-striped` / `data-striped-color` (table striping), `data-watermark` +
  `data-watermark-rotate`/`-color`/`-size`/`-opacity`/`-font`/`-layer`, `data-page`
  (target page for an `absolute`/`fixed` block), `data-rotate="<deg>"`.
  **Row grouping / group subtotals are JS-IR only — no HTML attribute enables them.**
  Internal `#` links resolve against an element's standard **`id`** attribute.
- **Special blocks are attribute-triggered** on any element (not `type=`):
  - **Barcode:** `data-barcode="qr|code128|ean13"` + `data-value` (or `data-bind`), with
    `data-error-correction`, `data-module-size`, `data-quiet-zone`, `data-show-text`, `data-color`.
  - **Chart:** `data-chart="<kind>"` (or `data-kind`) on an element or a `<table>`; data via
    `data-categories`, `data-series` / `data-name`+`data-values`+`data-color`; options:
    `data-title`, `data-colors` (palette), `data-stacked`, `data-legend`, `data-show-values`,
    `data-min`/`data-max`/`data-ticks`/`data-value-format`/`data-x-format`, `data-axis-labels`,
    `data-category-labels`, `data-grid`/`data-grid-lines`, `data-reference-lines`, `data-range`,
    combo `data-series-types`/`data-series-axes` (+ right-axis `data-right-*`), scatter/bubble/range
    `data-series-x`/`data-series-r`/`data-series-low`/`data-series-high`, `data-totals`/
    `data-waterfall-colors` (waterfall), `data-inner-radius`/`data-plot-height`, gauge
    `data-gauge-value`/`data-gauge-max`, heatmap `data-heatmap-labels`/`data-heatmap-colors`,
    gantt `data-gantt-tasks`/`data-gantt-start`/`data-gantt-end`/`data-gantt-unit`.
  - **TOC:** an element with `data-toc` (+ `data-title`, `data-max-level`, `data-leaders`,
    `data-indent`, `data-page-numbers`, `data-gap`). A `.toc { outline: true }` CSS rule
    only adds heading section-numbering; the block itself needs `data-toc`.
  - **Multi-column:** `data-columns="N"` (+ `data-column-gap`, `data-column-rule`) or CSS `column-count`.

## 14. Conditional formatting

- **`styleWhen: StyleCondition[]`** on blocks, rows and cells:
  `{ when: string | Expr, style?: Partial<BoxProps> }`. Rules apply in array order, last
  match wins; evaluated in the current scope (`$row`, `$group`, `$index`, `$page`).
- **`colorScale: ColorScale`** on a cell or column: `{ min?, max?, from? ('#eef4ff'),
  to? ('#1e3a8a'), text? (default true → white on dark fills) }`. When `min`/`max` are
  omitted the range is computed per column from the table's data rows (one declaration
  shades a whole column).
- **`visible: boolean | Expr`** hides a block/row/cell (a hidden cell keeps its grid slot).

## 15. CLI (offline, auto-detected CJK fonts via fontconfig)

```bash
npx pdf-report-engine-html report.html out.pdf --data report.data.json
# or after npm install:
node node_modules/pdf-report-engine/dist/cli/html-to-pdf.js report.html out.pdf -d report.data.json
```
Prints `wrote N pages`. For arbitrary Unicode/online images use the JS API instead.

## 16. Recipes (copy-paste)

### Grouped data table with subtotals + running pages
See `examples/02-data-table.mjs`. Key shape:
```js
data: { rows },
variables: { grandTotal: rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0) },
bands: {
  pageFooter: { height: 20, style: { fontSize: 8 },
    blocks: [{ type: 'paragraph', align: 'right',
      content: ['Page ', { bind: '$page.number' }, ' of ', { bind: '$page.total' }] }] },
  summary: { text: [{ bind: "concat('Grand total: ', money($vars.grandTotal))" }] },
},
body: [{ type: 'table', repeatHeader: true, dataSource: { bind: '$data.rows' },
  columns: [{ key: 'region', grow: 1 }, { key: 'amount', width: 110, align: 'right' }],
  groups: [{ by: '$row.region',
    footer: [{ bind: "concat('Subtotal — ', money($group.amount_sum))" }] }],
  detail: { cells: [{ bind: 'region' }, { bind: 'amount', format: '#,##0.00' }] } }]
```

### Online images (with a custom loader)
```js
await renderToBuffer(report, {
  images: { resolveImage: async (url) => myFetch(url), timeoutMs: 10_000, onError: 'throw' },
});
// report.body: [{ type: 'image', src: 'https://cdn.example.com/chart.png', width: 180 }]
```

### Fonts for CJK / arbitrary Unicode (offline)
```js
import { createReport, resolveRemoteFonts } from 'pdf-report-engine';
const fonts = await resolveRemoteFonts(report);            // from report.fonts refs
const { doc } = createReport(report, { fonts });
doc.end(); doc.pipe(fs.createWriteStream('out.pdf'));
// Then per-glyph fallback + auto-subsetting handles CJK with no font-family per block.
```

### Streaming to an HTTP response
```js
const stream = await renderToStream(report, { images: { allowedHosts: ['cdn.example.com'] } });
return new Response(stream, { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/pdf' } });
```

### TOC + bookmarks + links
```js
body: [
  { type: 'toc', title: 'Contents', maxLevel: 3 },
  { type: 'pageBreak' },
  { type: 'heading', level: 1, content: 'Introduction', id: 'intro' },
  // …more headings…
]
// outline is automatic; internal links use { link: '#intro' } (matching a block id).
```
